description: DARAMS live daily operating layer: current state, tomorrow recommendations, holdings, and alpha configuration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id, as_of_date, mode, run_purpose, is_official, status, data_source, data_max_date, data_lag_days, data_freshness_status, production_model_id, n_feature_alphas, feature_columns_hash, retrain_action, frozen_selector_id, selector_snapshot_hash, diagnostic_selector_snapshot_hash, run_started_at, run_finished_at FROM daily_live_runs WHERE is_official = true ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tr.action, tr.security_id, tr.current_weight, tr.target_weight, tr.delta_weight, tr.current_shares, tr.target_shares, tr.delta_shares, tr.last_price, tr.signal_score, tr.rank, tr.reason, tr.status FROM trade_recommendations tr JOIN (SELECT run_id FROM daily_live_runs WHERE is_official = true ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON r.run_id = tr.run_id WHERE tr.action <> 'HOLD' ORDER BY CASE tr.action WHEN 'BUY' THEN 1 WHEN 'INCREASE' THEN 2 WHEN 'REDUCE' THEN 3 WHEN 'SELL' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, abs(tr.delta_weight) DESC

SELECT ps.security_id, ps.target_weight, ps.target_shares, ps.last_price, ps.market_value, ps.signal_score, ps.rank, ps.holding_days, ps.reason FROM portfolio_snapshots ps JOIN (SELECT run_id FROM daily_live_runs WHERE is_official = true ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON r.run_id = ps.run_id WHERE abs(ps.target_weight) > 0 ORDER BY ps.target_weight DESC

SELECT s.alpha_id, s.selected, s.weight, s.score, s.rolling_rank_ic, s.coverage, s.stability, s.excluded_reason FROM alpha_selection_scores s JOIN (SELECT run_id FROM daily_live_runs WHERE is_official = true ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON r.run_id = s.run_id WHERE s.snapshot_role = 'production' AND s.selected = true ORDER BY s.alpha_id

SELECT s.alpha_id, s.selected, s.weight, s.score, s.rolling_rank_ic, s.coverage, s.stability, s.excluded_reason FROM alpha_selection_scores s JOIN (SELECT run_id FROM daily_live_runs WHERE is_official = true ORDER BY as_of_date DESC, run_started_at DESC LIMIT 1) r ON r.run_id = s.run_id WHERE s.snapshot_role = 'diagnostic' ORDER BY s.selected DESC, s.score DESC NULLS LAST, s.alpha_id
